motifs.name: prefix-sum two-scale influence area margin
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups as captured, builds a fast influence field from 3x3 and 7x7 stone counts using prefix sums, assigns each board point to the side whose weighted influence outweighs the other by at least two, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this influence area by a komi-aware margin.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'prefix-sum two-scale influence area margin'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Removes one-liberty groups as captured, builds a fast influence field from 3x3 and 7x7 stone counts using prefix sums, assigns each board point to the side whose weighted influence outweighs the other by at least two, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this influence area by a komi-aware margin.'

def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    N = 19
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    dirs = ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))
    grid = [list(r) for r in board_rows]
    seen = [[False] * N for _ in range(N)]
    for r in range(N):
        for c in range(N):
            ch = board_rows[r][c]
            if ch == '.' or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen[r][c] = True
            cells = [(r, c)]
            libs = set()
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for dy, dx in dirs:
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < N and 0 <= nx < N:
                        v = board_rows[ny][nx]
                        if v == '.':
                            libs.add((ny, nx))
                        elif v == ch and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx] = True
                            stack.append((ny, nx))
                            cells.append((ny, nx))
            if len(libs) <= 1:
                for y, x in cells:
                    grid[y][x] = '.'
    PB = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    PW = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for r in range(N):
        rb = PB[r + 1]
        rw = PW[r + 1]
        pb = PB[r]
        pw = PW[r]
        g = grid[r]
        for c in range(N):
            v = g[c]
            rb[c + 1] = rb[c] + pb[c + 1] - pb[c] + (1 if v == 'B' else 0)
            rw[c + 1] = rw[c] + pw[c + 1] - pw[c] + (1 if v == 'W' else 0)
    pts = {'B': 0, 'W': 0}
    for r in range(N):
        r1a = r - 1 if r - 1 > 0 else 0
        r1b = r + 2 if r + 2 < N else N
        r3a = r - 3 if r - 3 > 0 else 0
        r3b = r + 4 if r + 4 < N else N
        B1a = PB[r1a]
        B1b = PB[r1b]
        W1a = PW[r1a]
        W1b = PW[r1b]
        B3a = PB[r3a]
        B3b = PB[r3b]
        W3a = PW[r3a]
        W3b = PW[r3b]
        for c in range(N):
            c1a = c - 1 if c - 1 > 0 else 0
            c1b = c + 2 if c + 2 < N else N
            c3a = c - 3 if c - 3 > 0 else 0
            c3b = c + 4 if c + 4 < N else N
            b1 = B1b[c1b] - B1a[c1b] - B1b[c1a] + B1a[c1a]
            w1 = W1b[c1b] - W1a[c1b] - W1b[c1a] + W1a[c1a]
            b3 = B3b[c3b] - B3a[c3b] - B3b[c3a] + B3a[c3a]
            w3 = W3b[c3b] - W3a[c3b] - W3b[c3a] + W3a[c3a]
            d = 2 * (b1 - w1) + (b3 - w3)
            if d >= 2:
                pts['B'] += 1
            elif d <= -2:
                pts['W'] += 1
    diff = pts[color] - pts[opp]
    thr = 9 if color == 'B' else 2
    return diff >= thr

motifs.name: weak enemy groups and capture differential
motifs.description: Returns True when opponent stones trapped in one or two liberty groups plus net captured stones, estimated from parity-adjusted stone counts, clearly outweigh the evaluated side own weak stones.

motifs.name: unlimited-ray unanimous enclosure area margin
motifs.description: Deletes one-liberty groups and two-liberty groups that face an adjacent enemy group with four or more liberties, casts unbounded orthogonal rays from every empty point to the first remaining stone in each direction, awards the point only when at least two rays hit stones and every hit is the same color, adds surviving stones, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this strictly-enclosed area by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: perpendicular ray-pair braced territory margin
motifs.description: Deletes one-liberty chains and small hopeless two-liberty chains whose every liberty touches an enemy stone, finds each empty point nearest stone along the four orthogonal directions, awards the point to a color that holds both rays of some perpendicular pair within four steps while no ray meets that color enemy within three, adds surviving stones plus a capture bonus, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this corner-braced territory by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: contested-region perimeter-share area margin
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups as captured, flood-fills each maximal empty region, splits its points between the colors in proportion to their shares of the region stone perimeter so contested and neutral areas yield partial credit, adds live stones, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this proportional area estimate by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: contact fight liberty superiority
motifs.description: Compares liberty counts for every pair of adjacent opposing groups and returns True when the evaluated side holds the liberty advantage in clearly more contact fights than it concedes.

motifs.name: same-color flanked line-segment territory margin
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups as captured, scans every row and column for empty runs bracketed on both ends by stones of one color within eight points or by one stone and the board edge within five, awards each such sandwiched run to that color per axis, counts live stones double, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this sandwich-territory area by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: capture-parity and eye-mouth shape blend margin
motifs.description: Estimates net captures from black-minus-white stone-count parity for the evaluated side to move, adds a solid-shape differential that counts fully own-wrapped empty eye points as two and interior three-quarter tiger mouths as one after deleting one-liberty groups, and returns True when twice the capture estimate plus the shape edge clears a komi-aware threshold.

motifs.name: capped dual-axis nearest-stone consensus area margin
motifs.description: Removes chains in atari, awards each empty point using the nearest surviving stone within five steps along its row and its column, claiming it only when both axes agree or exactly one axis sees a stone while per-axis ties and cross-axis conflicts stay neutral, adds surviving stones, and fires when the evaluated side leads this consensus area by a komi-aware coverage-scaled threshold.

motifs.name: deep uncontested space differential
motifs.description: After deleting groups with at most two liberties as presumed dead, counts empty points whose 5x5 neighborhood contains at least three stones of one side and none of the enemy, and returns True when the evaluated side leads in such deep secure space by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: healthy-chain unchallenged perimeter band
motifs.description: Prunes captured one-liberty chains and hopeless two-liberty chains, keeps only remaining chains of two or more stones with at least four liberties, counts each such strong chain liberty point that touches no adjacent enemy stone as unchallenged wall frontage, and fires when the evaluated side leads this healthy-perimeter count by a komi-aware margin inside a capped band that excludes blowouts.

motifs.name: wall-shielded buffered territory differential
motifs.description: Counts empty points within two empty-path steps of a healthy three-plus-liberty group of one side while every healthy enemy group is at least five empty-path steps away, and returns True when the evaluated side leads in such wall-shielded territory by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: solid wall frontier point differential
motifs.description: After deleting one-liberty groups as captured, counts empty points touching at least two stones of one side and none of the enemy, and returns True when the evaluated side leads in these wall-backed frontier points by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: dominant connected army size gap
motifs.description: Deletes one-liberty groups and hopeless two-liberty groups whose every liberty touches an enemy stone, links surviving same-color stones through orthogonal and diagonal adjacency into armies, sums each side two largest armies, and returns True when the evaluated side top forces outweigh the opponent top forces by a komi-aware stone margin.

motifs.name: undercut-vetoed border-ray frontage margin
motifs.description: Prunes one-liberty chains, casts a ray inward from each of the 76 edge entry points, awards the ray to the first surviving stone found within six steps with credit one plus its empty approach depth unless an enemy stone in the two cells directly behind that stone marks the frontage contested, and fires when the evaluated side leads this edge-frontage total by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: dead-pruned tie-neutral voronoi score margin
motifs.description: Removes groups in atari and hopeless two-liberty groups, spreads one tie-aware breadth-first ownership wave up to six steps from the remaining stones so equidistant frontier points stay neutral, sums owned empty points plus live stones, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this score by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: compass-band sealed stone encirclement differential
motifs.description: Marks a stone encircled when every compass direction is closed off either by the nearby board edge or by a five-by-five directional band holding strictly more enemy than friendly stones, requires at least two enemy-dominant directions with four or more enemy stones in them, and fires when the opponent carries a komi-aware surplus of encircled stones over the evaluated side.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'compass-band sealed stone encirclement differential'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Marks a stone encircled when every compass direction is closed off either by the nearby board edge or by a five-by-five directional band holding strictly more enemy than friendly stones, requires at least two enemy-dominant directions with four or more enemy stones in them, and fires when the opponent carries a komi-aware surplus of encircled stones over the evaluated side.'

def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    N = 19
    RB = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    RW = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    for r in range(N):
        row = board_rows[r]
        pb = [0] * (N + 1)
        pw = [0] * (N + 1)
        for c in range(N):
            v = row[c]
            pb[c + 1] = pb[c] + (1 if v == 'B' else 0)
            pw[c + 1] = pw[c] + (1 if v == 'W' else 0)
        rb = RB[r]
        rw = RW[r]
        for c in range(N):
            c0 = c - 2 if c > 2 else 0
            c1 = c + 3 if c + 3 <= N else N
            rb[c] = pb[c1] - pb[c0]
            rw[c] = pw[c1] - pw[c0]
    PBc = [[0] * N for _ in range(N + 1)]
    PWc = [[0] * N for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for r in range(N):
        row = board_rows[r]
        a = PBc[r]; b = PBc[r + 1]
        aw = PWc[r]; bw = PWc[r + 1]
        for c in range(N):
            v = row[c]
            b[c] = a[c] + (1 if v == 'B' else 0)
            bw[c] = aw[c] + (1 if v == 'W' else 0)
    VB = [[0] * N for _ in range(N + 1)]
    VW = [[0] * N for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for r in range(N):
        a = VB[r]; b = VB[r + 1]; rb = RB[r]
        aw = VW[r]; bw = VW[r + 1]; rw = RW[r]
        for c in range(N):
            b[c] = a[c] + rb[c]
            bw[c] = aw[c] + rw[c]
    HB = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N)]
    HW = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N)]
    for r in range(N):
        r0 = r - 2 if r > 2 else 0
        r1 = r + 3 if r + 3 <= N else N
        pa = PBc[r0]; pb2 = PBc[r1]
        wa = PWc[r0]; wb2 = PWc[r1]
        hb = HB[r]; hw = HW[r]
        for c in range(N):
            hb[c + 1] = hb[c] + pb2[c] - pa[c]
            hw[c + 1] = hw[c] + wb2[c] - wa[c]
    encB = 0
    encW = 0
    for r in range(N):
        row = board_rows[r]
        vbr = VB[r]; vwr = VW[r]
        vb0 = VB[r - 5 if r > 5 else 0]; vw0 = VW[r - 5 if r > 5 else 0]
        vb1 = VB[r + 6 if r + 6 <= N else N]; vw1 = VW[r + 6 if r + 6 <= N else N]
        vbs = VB[r + 1]; vws = VW[r + 1]
        hb = HB[r]; hw = HW[r]
        ne = r <= 1
        se = r >= 17
        for c in range(N):
            v = row[c]
            if v == '.':
                continue
            nb = vbr[c] - vb0[c]
            nw = vwr[c] - vw0[c]
            sb = vb1[c] - vbs[c]
            sw = vw1[c] - vws[c]
            c0 = c - 5 if c > 5 else 0
            c1 = c + 6 if c + 6 <= N else N
            wb = hb[c] - hb[c0]
            ww = hw[c] - hw[c0]
            eb = hb[c1] - hb[c + 1]
            ew = hw[c1] - hw[c + 1]
            if v == 'B':
                pairs = ((nw, nb, ne), (sw, sb, se), (ww, wb, c <= 1), (ew, eb, c >= 17))
            else:
                pairs = ((nb, nw, ne), (sb, sw, se), (wb, ww, c <= 1), (eb, ew, c >= 17))
            sealed = 0
            dom = 0
            etot = 0
            for e, f, edge in pairs:
                if e > f:
                    sealed += 1
                    dom += 1
                    etot += e
                elif edge:
                    sealed += 1
            if sealed == 4 and dom >= 2 and etot >= 4:
                if v == 'B':
                    encB += 1
                else:
                    encW += 1
    if color == 'B':
        return encW - encB >= 3
    return encB - encW >= 1

motifs.name: dual-diagonal sandwiched lane score margin
motifs.description: Prunes one-liberty chains, scans all diagonal lanes in both orientations for empty runs of at most five points bracketed by stones of one color or at most two points sealed by a stone against the lane end, gives each run point one claim per agreeing orientation with opposite-color claims cancelling to neutral, adds surviving stones, and fires when the evaluated side leads this diagonal-lane score by a komi-aware signed threshold.

motifs.name: majority-controlled line count differential
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups as captured, scores each of the 38 rows and columns by own stones plus empty runs sandwiched by that color within six points or running to the edge within four, declares a line controlled when one side leads its score by three or more, and returns True when the evaluated side controls a komi-aware surplus of lines rather than a raw point margin.

motifs.name: one-ply unsavable trapped-runner stone differential
motifs.description: Simulates every one-move extension for each chain with at most three liberties, crediting connections to friendly chains and captures of adjacent one-liberty enemy chains, marks chains that still cannot reach three liberties and lack capture relief as unsavable, and returns True when the opponent holds a komi-aware surplus of stones in such trapped chains.

motifs.name: weighted corner control differential
motifs.description: Scores each of the four 7x7 corner zones with stones weighted by group health and closeness to the corner, assigns a corner to the side that clearly outweighs the other there, and returns True when the evaluated side owns a komi-aware surplus of corners.

motifs.name: nearest-enemy distance-weighted freedom margin
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups as captured, weights every surviving stone by its Manhattan distance to the nearest surviving enemy stone capped at four so unengaged backline stones count more than contact-fight stones, and returns True when the evaluated side leads this engagement-freedom total by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: anchor-blocked-field buried chain stone differential
motifs.description: Selects each side settled anchor chains by liberty count and eye-like liberties, spreads breadth-first fields from the anchors that cannot pass through enemy stones, marks a non-anchor low-liberty chain as buried when every open liberty sits close to enemy anchors and at least two legal-path steps farther from its own anchors while any sealed pocket behind it stays tiny, and fires when the opponent total of buried stones exceeds the evaluated side total by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: conceded-half trade win with banded net lead
motifs.description: Prunes chains in atari and hopeless two-liberty chains, awards each empty point to a side whose surviving stones lie within three empty-path steps and at least two steps closer than the enemy, splits the board into top-bottom and left-right halves around an excluded center line, and fires when in some split the evaluated side clearly concedes one half yet wins the opposite half strongly enough that the komi-aware net lands in a moderate band, isolating trade-style wins that global-margin detectors read as only a modest overall edge.

motifs.name: unbraced loose-influence sightline majority margin
motifs.description: Prunes chains in atari and hopeless two-liberty chains, awards each empty point via eight-direction sightlines within six steps to the side whose visible stones outnumber the enemy by three, deliberately discards points that side already braces with perpendicular stones within four steps and no close enemy so tight territory is ignored, and fires when the evaluated side leads on the remaining loose unbraced influence points by a komi-aware margin under a blowout cap.

motifs.name: weighted center zone control differential
motifs.description: Scores the central 9x9 zone with stones weighted by group health and closeness to tengen, and returns True when the evaluated side outweighs the opponent there by a komi-aware margin.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'weighted center zone control differential'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Scores the central 9x9 zone with stones weighted by group health and closeness to tengen, and returns True when the evaluated side outweighs the opponent there by a komi-aware margin.'

def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    N = 19
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    gid = [[-1] * N for _ in range(N)]
    libs = []
    g = 0
    for r in range(N):
        for c in range(N):
            ch = board_rows[r][c]
            if ch == '.' or gid[r][c] != -1:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            gid[r][c] = g
            ls = set()
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < N and 0 <= nx < N:
                        v = board_rows[ny][nx]
                        if v == '.':
                            ls.add((ny, nx))
                        elif v == ch and gid[ny][nx] == -1:
                            gid[ny][nx] = g
                            stack.append((ny, nx))
            libs.append(len(ls))
            g += 1
    sb = 0.0
    sw = 0.0
    for r in range(5, 14):
        for c in range(5, 14):
            ch = board_rows[r][c]
            if ch == '.':
                continue
            L = libs[gid[r][c]]
            h = 1.0 if L >= 3 else (0.5 if L == 2 else 0.1)
            d = abs(r - 9)
            dc = abs(c - 9)
            if dc > d:
                d = dc
            pw = 2.0 if d <= 2 else (1.5 if d == 3 else 1.0)
            v = pw * h
            if ch == 'B':
                sb += v
            else:
                sw += v
    diff = (sb - sw) if color == 'B' else (sw - sb)
    thr = 5.0 if color == 'B' else 1.5
    return diff >= thr

motifs.name: edge-pinned low-line liberty group differential
motifs.description: Finds enemy-contacted chains with two to four liberties whose every liberty lies on the first two lines so the group is pinned flat against the edge with no route toward the center, weights each by capped size plus low-liberty and first-line bonuses, and returns True when the opponent carries a komi-aware surplus of such edge-pinned stones over the evaluated side.

motifs.name: healthy stone block presence differential
motifs.description: Divides the board into a 5x5 grid of blocks, awards a block to a side when only that side has stones from groups with three or more liberties inside it, and returns True when the evaluated side holds a komi-aware surplus of exclusively held blocks.

motifs.name: locally swamped stone mass differential
motifs.description: Marks each stone whose 7x7 neighborhood contains at least four more enemy stones than friendly supporters as locally swamped, and returns True when the opponent carries a komi-aware surplus of such swamped stones.

motifs.name: triangular sector breadth-band majority
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups, splits the board into four edge-facing triangular sectors, scores each by live stones plus empty points whose 3x3 neighborhood holds only one color, marks a sector won or lost when the gap is at least two, and fires only in a komi-aware band where the evaluated side wins clearly more sectors than it loses yet stops short of a total four-sector sweep.

motifs.name: sparse long-link skeleton lead under capped frontier
motifs.description: Prunes chains in atari and hopeless two-liberty chains, counts calm long-range framework links per side, namely knight moves, two-space jumps, and large-knight pairs whose in-between points are all empty and free of adjacent enemy stones, and fires when the evaluated side leads this sparse skeleton count by a komi-aware banded margin while the solid wall-frontier differential stays capped, targeting moyo-style wins that solid-territory detectors underrate.

motifs.name: outnumbered medium-liberty race stones differential
motifs.description: Sums stones of groups with two to four liberties that face an adjacent enemy group holding at least two more liberties, and returns True when the opponent has clearly more such race-losing stones than the evaluated side.

motifs.name: low-line profit lead under neutral-center gate
motifs.description: Prunes captured chains and hopeless two-liberty chains, awards an empty point on the first three lines to a side having at least two stones and zero enemy stones within Manhattan distance two, measures the same disc ownership over the central lines five and beyond, and fires when the evaluated side holds a komi-aware mid-band lead in this low-line profit while the disc-owned center stays roughly neutral or mildly against it, isolating edge-territory wins that global influence, frontier, and voronoi detectors rank differently.

motifs.name: liberty-gated dame majority differential
motifs.description: Scans every neutral empty point orthogonally touching both colors, awards it to the side holding at least two more stones in the surrounding 3x3 whose adjacent group liberties are also not inferior, and returns True when the evaluated side collects a komi-aware surplus of these contact-frontier points.

motifs.name: cramped escape-space dragon differential
motifs.description: Flags groups of three or more stones with two to five liberties, fewer than two strict own eyes, and at most six empty points reachable within three orthogonal steps from their liberties, and returns True when the opponent holds a komi-aware surplus of stones in such space-starved groups.

motifs.name: weakest substantial group safety gap
motifs.description: Finds each side weakest group of three or more stones by capped liberty count and returns True when the evaluated side weakest such group is safer than the opponent weakest by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: weighted edge zone control differential
motifs.description: Scores the four side zones between the corners with stones weighted by group health and closeness to the third line, awards each edge to the side that clearly outweighs the other there, and returns True when the evaluated side holds a komi-aware surplus of edges.

motifs.name: smothered no-breath chain stone differential
motifs.description: Finds chains of two or more stones with two to five liberties where every single liberty point orthogonally touches an enemy stone so the chain is fully enveloped with no free breathing room, weights each by capped size plus a low-liberty bonus, and returns True when the opponent carries a komi-aware surplus of such smothered stones over the evaluated side.

motifs.name: double-atari fork point tempo differential
motifs.description: Finds playable empty points that orthogonally touch two or more distinct low-liberty enemy chains so one move delivers a double atari or an atari plus squeeze, weights strict double ataris double, and fires when the evaluated side holds a komi-aware surplus of such fork points over those aimed back at it while the plain weak-stone gap stays capped so it is not mere capture counting.

motifs.name: sealed dead group value differential
motifs.description: Flood-fills regions of one color plus empty points to find groups sealed inside enemy walls with under two eyes and tiny eye space, returning True when the point value of opponent dead stones clearly exceeds that of the evaluated side.

motifs.name: doomed friendless orphan stone differential
motifs.description: Finds stones with no same-color support within Chebyshev distance two yet enemy stones that close, grades each orphan by nearby enemy count plus a bonus when even distance three holds no friend, and returns True when the opponent carries a komi-aware surplus of these doomed orphan stones over the evaluated side.

motifs.name: largest exclusive territory chunk gap
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups as captured, flood-fills empty regions, credits a region to the side holding at least four-fifths of its bordering stone contacts with a minimum of four, and returns True when the evaluated side single biggest credited region reaches six points and out-sizes the opponent best chunk by a komi-aware margin.

motifs.name: center-floating baseless weak-group stone differential
motifs.description: Sums a weight for every group of two or more stones with two to four liberties whose stones all sit at least two lines off every edge so the chain floats without a base, adding extra weight for two-liberty and deep-center floaters, and returns True when the opponent carries a komi-aware surplus of such floating weak stones over the evaluated side.

motifs.name: two-eyed living stone differential
motifs.description: Removes one-liberty groups as captured, credits groups with eye units from empty regions bordered by a single color using a diagonal false-eye test for single points, marks groups holding two or more eye units as alive, and returns True when the evaluated side leads in living stones by a color-scaled margin.

motifs.name: open-area chebyshev halo lead off the contact frontier
motifs.description: Prunes chains in atari and hopeless two-liberty chains, ignores every empty point orthogonally touching a stone so settled pockets and contact frontiers drop out, awards each remaining open-area point to the side whose nearest surviving stone is at least two Chebyshev steps closer within a three-step halo, keeps the solid wall-frontier differential under a loose cap, and fires when the evaluated side leads this off-frontier proximity count inside a komi-aware band, catching wins built on loose reach over open space rather than finished territory.

metadata.score_definition: P(motif=True | winning) - P(motif=True | losing), preserved from the canonical discovery ranking.
